FIELDS.NAME: Wanderlust Travel Agency
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Wanderlust Travel Agency specializes in providing comprehensive travel planning services for leisure and business travelers. Our core operations include offering custom travel itineraries, booking accommodations, securing transportation, and arranging activities and tours tailored to our clients' preferences. We prioritize customer safety by maintaining strong partnerships with reputable vendors, ensuring all travel arrangements are made through fully regulated airlines, hotels, and transportation services. In addition, we conduct annual risk assessments of all travel destinations, focusing on low-risk regions with established tourism infrastructures. Our commitment to cybersecurity is reflected in our documented policies, regular employee training, and stringent controls over customer data to protect against potential data breaches. By fostering these best practices, we strive to provide exceptional travel experiences while maintaining the highest standards of safety and compliance.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: Loss dates: January 2023, Cause: Cancellation of group tour due to unforeseen travel restrictions, Amount: $1,500.00, Status: Resolved. Loss dates: February 2023, Cause: Minor data breach resulting from outdated software, Amount: $500.00, Status: Pending resolution.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM; Saturday, 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM; Closed on Sunday
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Fire-safe, UL-listed secure vault, grade A, labeled for cash and documents storage.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Security personnel present during operational hours to monitor facility and customer safety.

FIELDS.G7: Any Workers Compensation carried?: No – Wanderlust Travel Agency does not currently have any Workers Compensation insurance in place, but we are aware of the legal requirements and are in the process of obtaining coverage.

FIELDS.G9: Any other insurance with this compan: No – Wanderlust Travel Agency does not have any other insurance policies with this company at this time. All current coverage is outlined under the existing policy number WTA-2023001.
FIELDS.G10: Are you involved in manufacturing,: No – Wanderlust Travel Agency is not involved in manufacturing, mixing, relabeling, or repackaging of products. Our operations are focused solely on providing travel planning and booking services for leisure and business travelers.
FIELDS.G11: Do you rent or loan equipment to ot: No – Wanderlust Travel Agency does not rent or loan equipment to others as our operations focus solely on travel planning and booking services. We prioritize customer safety by partnering with reputable vendors for all travel-related needs.
FIELDS.G12: Has applicant had a foreclosure, re: No – Wanderlust Travel Agency has not had any foreclosure, repossession, bankruptcy, judgment, or lien during the past five years. The company maintains a strong financial position and operates within its means.
FIELDS.G13: Any exposure to flammables, explosi: No – Wanderlust Travel Agency does not have any exposure to flammables, explosives, or chemicals as our operations focus exclusively on travel planning and booking services, which do not involve such materials. Our commitment to customer safety includes partnering with fully regulated vendors for all travel needs.
FIELDS.G14: Any catastrophe exposure?: No – Wanderlust Travel Agency does not have any catastrophe exposure as our operations focus primarily on travel planning and do not involve high-risk activities or locations associated with catastrophic events. All travel arrangements are made through reputable, regulated vendors in low-risk regions.
FIELDS.G15: Any past losses or claims relating: No – Wanderlust Travel Agency has not had any past losses or claims relating to sexual abuse or molestation allegations, discrimination, or negligent hiring. We prioritize safety and compliance in our operations and vendor partnerships.
FIELDS.G16: Any uncorrected fire code violation: No – Wanderlust Travel Agency has no uncorrected fire code violations and maintains compliance with all fire safety regulations to ensure the safety of our operations.
